data.name: Payout_Country_Help
data.value: ISO country code, e.g. CH. The provider fixes this when the account is created and never lets it change – a wrong value means starting over with a new account.

data.name: Payout_EntityType_Help
data.value: Decides which documents the provider asks for.

data.name: Payout_ContactEmail_Help
data.value: Where the provider writes about THIS account. Empty: the billing profile's address is used.

data.name: Payout_DisplayName_Help
data.value: What the end customer sees, on the payment page and on their statement. Empty: the name from the billing profile.

data.name: Payout_BusinessUrl_Help
data.value: Part of what the provider verifies the business against.

data.name: Payout_Country_Invalid
data.value: The country is an ISO code of two letters, e.g. CH.

data.name: Payout_BusinessUrl_Invalid
data.value: The web address needs its scheme, e.g. https://shop.example.com.
